name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Turn a software goal into parallel work, atomic commits, agent prompts, and clear integration handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a goal into parallel, commit-ready work.
interface.longDescription: Build a fast provisional topology from repository maps, return the task index first, then let concurrent subagents verify implementation and land bounded coding-agent prompts independently.
capabilities: Turn goals into executable work plans
Choose lean, balanced, or thorough prompt depth
Dispatch prompt details with concurrent subagents
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this goal into a dependency-aware plan using a fast map-first scan of repository instructions, design and convention documents, schemas, contracts, build metadata, and file structure. Return the provisional task index first. Use subagents for thorough implementation verification and independent prompt-detail tasks. Dispatch them concurrently and return immediately after dispatch.
